title: Silver Zoom Card: Triple Cash Back Promo - Terms and Conditions
summary: Terms and Conditions for the Silver Zoom Card Triple Cash Back Promo: you must claim between 2024-01-01 and 2025-12-31. After proper claim, a 9-month promo duration applies—transportation/logistics earns 3×3.0%, all other eligible purchases earn 3×1.0%, with earnings reduced for returns/credits and reverting to standard 3.0%/1.0% after 9 months.
